script: Breaking news, everyone. Word from Lonzo Ball himself has apparently decided that Lonzo Ball has retired. Earlier today, reports started spreading that Lonzo Ball was officially done with basketball. After comments he made on the Ball in the Family podcast, Lonzo reflected on everything he went through with injury saying he gave everything he had to basketball, was great for to play nine years in the NBA, and these statements sounded like a retirement speech. I felt like I never shortchanged the game. Like I felt like I gave everything I had to a hoop and I felt like everything I got in my life is because of hoop. So I'm grateful to even make it to the league and and do even be able to play for nine years you feel me? So that's how I look at it. I kind of look at it like halfway full or not, halfway empty type of thing. But he clearly never stated he retired. That didn't stop social media from running with it, getting multiple accounts and even news outlets reporting that Lonzo Ball had officially retired. There's just one problem: he never actually did that or said that he was retiring. So to clear things up, basically everyone bouncing his retirement for him, Lonzo Ball says he's still trying to play, for now he remains an unsigned free agent waiting for another NBA opportunity.
